name: Melee PC
game: Super Smash Bros. Melee (GameCube, USA revision 2)

inputs.description: Import your own USA revision 2 disc into the app after installation. Game assets are not included in the personal IPA.

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install full Xcode with the iOS platform and select its command-line tools.

tools.name: $HOME/.cargo/bin/rustup
tools.note: Install Rustup. The recipe installs the pinned Rust 1.96.0 iPhone compiler.
tools.label: Rustup

publication.reason: PadMint downloads pinned upstream source and builds the patched app privately on the player's Mac. The output contains compiled game code and remains personal.

notes: Separate from MeleePad. Apple Silicon Mac and Xcode required. Unsigned personal IPA requires the player's signing/install tool. No LiveContainer acceptance yet. No published base app is downloaded.
